target: tracker.sh shelve — records shelved_from, leaves PR/branch untouched
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: shipped
status: pr-open
branch: claude/idea-thing
pr: https://example.test/pull/9
claimed_by: review-loop
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; tracker_shelve factory/specs/001-a.md me 'superseded by hotfix' >/dev/null; jq -n --arg st "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg from "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_from)" --arg br "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md branch)" --arg pr "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md pr)" --arg cb "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md claimed_by)" --arg rs "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_reason)" --arg at "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_at)" '{st: $st, from: $from, br: $br, pr: $pr, cb: $cb, rs: $rs, at: $at}'
_note: branch/pr/claimed_by MUST survive a shelve byte-for-byte — that is the whole reason a shelve/restore round trip on a pr-open spec is exact rather than lossy. If a future edit makes shelve reset those fields, restoring the spec would orphan its PR.
